meta.title: useEffect — cleanup prevents memory leaks

annotations.label: Component declaration
annotations.detail: Timer subscribes to a setInterval in an effect. Without cleanup, the interval keeps firing after the component is removed or after the dep changes — stacking up multiple live intervals.

annotations.label: Cleanup captures intervalId
annotations.detail: The returned cleanup function closes over the specific intervalId created in this effect run. Each re-run creates a new id; each cleanup disposes exactly its own run's interval.

steps.note: The cleanup function (the return value) runs before the next effect
